idea.title: Dhol and lavani at the sangeet
idea.description: Open the sangeet with a dhol entry and close it with a lavani set, so both families' music gets a moment.

items.rationale: Mixes the Marathi and Punjabi traditions in one evening.

idea.title: Marigold and mogra entrance arch
idea.description: A pastel arch of marigold and mogra at the venue gate, in season in December.

items.rationale: Fits the pastel, floral vibe and the winter flower season.

idea.title: Kids' corner during the pheras
idea.description: A supervised craft corner near the mandap so the 30 children stay busy during the longer rituals.

items.rationale: 30 kids are coming and the wedding rituals run for hours.
